extraction.legacy_base.py: Overrides for step/post_physics/reset, rigid-body mass and shape friction, action delay, PD gains/torque, push and initialization. Remove disabled acoustic-material, FALCON and grouped-reward branches. Other behavior/assets inherited from pinned upstream.
extraction.runtime.py: Process-local task and actor registration without upstream edits. Default prism and degree1/2/3 use gated-v2 actors; legacy-* retains historical task IDs; residual-learned-gate and the four capacity recipes have explicit separate task IDs. The PPO compatibility hook advances scheduled warmup only on actors that expose advance_poly_warmup.
extraction.train.py: Retain upstream rollout and PPO optimizer updates. Propagate explicit nonnegative seeds to environment and training configuration before construction; require explicit resume selection. Reserve a fresh run directory and record resolved provenance, learned-gate optimizer membership and initial statistics. Log alpha statistics, bind saved checkpoints to seed/actor/manifest identity, correct periodic saved iteration metadata to the completed update count, and write checkpoint hashes plus a completion marker only after the full requested budget and final save. Reject checkpoint overwrites; these metadata changes do not alter the actor forward computation or PPO objective.
extraction.evaluate.py: Add explicit evaluation protocols. The default balanced protocol assigns equal episode quotas per environment, defines survival by the actual timeout flag, and captures terminal tracking errors before automatic reset. Explicit legacy-pooled retains the historical pooled-completion allocation, length-threshold survival and post-reset metric timing. Preserve strict actor/checkpoint selection and no-overwrite output; record per-episode data, resolved evaluation settings, source/runtime identity, checkpoint hashes and any available sibling training manifest. Historical checkpoints without a training manifest retain unknown training-seed provenance.
extraction.probes: Historical target/filter/fitting code retained; default gated degree2 representation, explicit legacy-prism selector preserves old residual representation; strict checkpoint selection and actor ID metadata.
extraction.provenance.py: Portable metadata helper for resolved configurations, recipe/class/actor identity, actual parameter counts, source/checkpoint hashes, git revisions when available and runtime versions. Recognize historical, gated-v2, residual learned-gate and optional capacity recipes. For the paired residual diagnostic, record initial shared-parameter SHA256 excluding only the new interaction-scales parameter; this records initial-state evidence without modifying model state.
extraction.run_suite.py: Explicit seed/variant matrix, previews by default; --execute launches training. Retain --dry-run as an explicit preview flag.
extraction.gated_actor.py: New release implementation, not a historical extraction: degree-K affine gated recurrence with learned per-feature alpha=.01, affine projection + ELU, unchanged G1 observation/action/critic interfaces. Strict actor_variant_version=2 marker. No scheduled warmup or historical raw skip.
extraction.checkpoints.py: Reject crossed MLP, historical residual, gated-v2 and residual learned-gate checkpoint schemas before simulator construction. Validate polynomial degree, gate dimensions and applicable warmup/version markers; distinct capacity widths still require the exact selected recipe and strict runner load. Historical weights are never silently converted to learned-gate variants.
extraction.residual_gated_actor.py: New diagnostic implementation based on the retained historical residual actor. Attach deterministic per-feature interaction scales initialized to 1 after all legacy actor/critic parameters are initialized, preserving the original RNG draw order, raw skip, affine transforms, ELU and 500-update warmup. Add version marker 3 and strict gate/warmup checkpoint validation. This is a separate g1_residual_learned_gate_v1 actor, not the default shared gated-v2 recurrence.
extraction.evaluation_protocol.py: Simulator-independent episode accounting and before-reset capture helper. Implement balanced per-environment quotas with timeout survival and terminal tracking-error accumulation, plus explicit historical pooled compatibility. Preserve individual episode identities, lengths, returns, tracking errors and protocol metadata for aggregate verification.
extraction.run_main_table.py: New fixed baseline/larger/default-gated-PRISM matrix: five fresh training seeds per method, 4096 training environments and 3001 PPO updates, with three balanced evaluations of 200 episodes across 100 environments per final checkpoint. Freeze integration and upstream source/resources, verify hashes and registered inputs, execute one subprocess at a time under a queue lock, and adopt only verified completed training/evaluation records. Final completion requires 15 training runs and 45 evaluations; partial jobs are preserved for inspection.
extraction.build_main_table.py: New standard-library reporter for the fixed three-method main suite. Validate training/evaluation seeds, actor schemas/counts, fresh-run budgets, source/runtime/configuration consistency, checkpoint and manifest bindings, balanced episode quotas and recomputed aggregate metrics. Average three evaluations within each training seed, then report mean and sample SD across five training seeds only when all required records are verified. Incomplete data remains pending; the reporter does not fabricate results or edit manuscript files.
extraction.run_residual_gate_controls.py: New shared implementation for closed immutable residual and capacity suite specifications. The default residual diagnostic compares five fresh legacy-prism seeds with five fresh residual-learned-gate seeds, preserving 500-update warmup and requiring equal initial shared-parameter hashes within each paired training seed. Reuse snapshot, launch and checkpoint-adoption helpers; independently validate actor/gate/configuration, source/runtime and balanced evaluation evidence. Reports require the full registered matrix, use evaluation-seed means followed by five-training-seed mean/sample SD, and verify actual reporter/helper hashes against the frozen plan.
extraction.run_capacity_controls.py: Thin entry point selecting the closed capacity specification: prism-1321k, mlp-1321k, mlp-wide-1500k and mlp-deep-1500k, in that order for each training seeds 1-5. Reuse the shared suite engine with exact per-recipe architecture and gate checks, 4096 environments, 3001 updates and three balanced 200-episode/100-environment evaluations per checkpoint. Require 20 fresh training runs and 60 evaluations before reporting capacity_summary statistics. Different architectures do not require equal initial shared-parameter hashes; this suite neither adopts archived checkpoints nor modifies an existing frozen suite.
extraction.MAIN_TABLE.md: Document the new five-seed main-suite evidence schema, complete/pending semantics, parameter counts and nested aggregation; no new benchmark measurements are supplied.
extraction.RESIDUAL_GATE_CONTROL.md: Document the historical residual versus learned-interaction-scale diagnostic, unit gate initialization, retained warmup, paired initialization evidence, fresh-run protocol and separate reports; archived checkpoint evaluations are explicitly distinct.
extraction.CAPACITY_COMPARISON.md: Document the optional wider gated-v2 recipe, parameter-matched and larger/deeper MLP controls, exact parameter counts, fresh five-seed protocol and separate capacity reports; architecture budgets do not assert performance improvements.
